row:
#KSAR is a licensed veterinary clinic and animal shelter in Kabul helping animals in need in Afghanistan, putting compassion into action. 501c3 EIN: 86-1456626

We provide routine & emergency medical services for pets, street animals, and working animals. Our staff, on site  24/7 intake can provide animal retrieval in Kabul City if needed, security allowing. Our facilities include quarantine areas to safely treat contagious diseases commonly found in Afghanistan, surgical suite, and long-term boarding, animal sanctuary spaces. 

On June 2, 2024 we pulled off the unimaginable- we airlifted 195 dogs and 100 cats on a charter plane bound for the USA. Almost all of these cats and dogs are in their forever homes in the US while a few are waiting to be adopted. Please reach out if you are interested in adopting a KSAR cutie.

Despite the airlift, today we have over 450 animals (including 250 dogs) residing at KSARl No animal is ever turned away and so our population is growing again.
